text_block_list.text:
With a number of wins under Голд Шип's
belt, we
have some time to bask in the
victorious
afterglow. However, the lull
doesn't last long.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: DANG IT!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I can't master this technique... I've been
trying so
hard, but I just can't nail the
shadow clone jutsu!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: Shadow clones? Where did I hear that before?

text_block_list.text:
Oh right, she did say something about
shadow
clones when she won the ticket
for a hot spring
vacation in that raffle.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It was supposed to be epic! The plan was
to have
twice the fun with my shadow
clone, but alas!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I just can't do it! And the ticket expires
real soon!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
There's no time to waste! I'm going on
vacation,
and you're coming with me!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
And so, I'm off on an extremely

spur-of-the-moment hot spring vacation
with
Голд Шип.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Things are going pretty well on the train
ride to
the inn. At least, until I turn to
my side.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: That's when I discover the seat where Голд Шип should be sitting is empty.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She doesn't answer any of my messages,
so I get
off the train at the next stop and
call her.
Thankfully, she picks up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. It's about time you
called."
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
"Walk 500 paces south from the station,
then go
700 paces east. I'll see you
there. Later."
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The line goes dead. I try calling her back
again
and again, but it won't go
through...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The instant I reach the spot she
indicated, my
phone suddenly rings out
of nowhere.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"Sup. Now go 700 paces north and
1,200 paces
west. See you there. Later."
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: She hangs up on me again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Once more, I follow her directions right
to...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You've done well to make it this far,
traveler.
Your journey must have been
difficult.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Many monsters roam these parts. The
peril is
grave, so please rest here for the
night.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Get inside. Quick, before you become a
monster's
dinner.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I have no idea what's going on, but since
I can't
simply leave Голд Шипп to her own
devices, I step
inside the inn.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You must be famished from your long
journey.
Fear not—a meal has already
been prepared.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Her fantasy innkeeper act doesn't drop
even after
we're inside. I get the feeling
she won't stop even
if I don't play along,
so I humor her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Here we have vegetable tempura,
vegetable miso
soup, and steamed
vegetables. Everything was
harvested in
the nearby mountains.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Next, we have vegetable sashimi,
flame-roasted
vegetables, soy sauce
simmered vegetables, and,
for the
adventurous, live vegetables straight
from
the earth.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Feel free to take a dip in the hot spring
when
you're done.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
After eating my veggie-packed dinner, I
make my
way to the hot spring.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I sit down in the massive bath. But then,
out of
nowhere...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Kraaaw!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A cry like no animal I've ever heard
echoes
through the night!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My pulse hasn't even had the time to
settle down
when I'm hit with another
shock.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: THUD!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The air trembles with the violent noise!
Terrified, I
jump out of the bath as
quickly as I can.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: That was a close call.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But fear not. The kraw bird has gone
yonder.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
You'll be safe inside the inn. Please,
relax to your
heart's content.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I shall also retire for the night. Have a
good rest.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm back in my room now, but I've still
got no idea
what's going on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The confounding situation has
thoroughly
exhausted me, and I drift to
sleЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I sense that Голд Шипп and I have formed
an
irreplaceable bond during this time
together...
Maybe. Who knows?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When I wake up, the first thing I see is
Голд Шип.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Let's kick things off with
some super
stretches!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: What're you talking about?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
We never left in the first place, so how
can we be
"back"? Quit messing around.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: What's going on?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Was all of that just a dream?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, when I check my inbox a few
days
later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's an email from an unknown
sender that
reads, "Thank you for
visiting our inn."
text_block_list.name: Монолог
